test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A person deposited Rs. 8,000 in a term deposit for 1 and a half year, which gives half yearly compounded interest at a rate of 10% per annum. The compound interest will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Deposited amount = 8000

TIme = one and half year = 18 months or 3 half year

Rate of interest = 10% per annum

Interest is compounded half yearly

Rate of interest for 6 month = 5%

**Concept:**

Amount (A) = P (1 + R/100)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Amount = 8000 × (1 + 5/100)³

= 8000 × (21/20)³

= 8000 × 21/20 × 21/20 × 21/20

= 21 × 21 × 21 

= 9261

The compound interest = 9261 - 8000 = 1261

∴ Compound interest will be 1261

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1678c1022aef7ad2a0d0a63a3d7094489f2beb53f9d9b8d3a2129f4d1e17b838.png] 

Successive percentage of 5%, 5% & 5% = 15.7625%

Total compound interest rate for 18 months = 15.7625%

So, the compound interest for 18 months = 8000 × 15.7625% = 1261

∴ Compound interest will be 1261
